text:
devops-jen: main CI turned red right after merging that dep bump for request-router 2.4.0 -> 2.5.0. failing step: smoke-gpu-allocator. Anyone able to grab? @sam-oncall
ci-bot: Job smoke-gpu-allocator-24 failed in step `kvalloc-init` on shard g1 (exit 137). Log: `OOM when allocating 1.2GiB` :warning:
sam-oncall: grabbing, lmk if you have bisect hints
devops-jen: thanks! logs pasted below
devops-jen: ```
[2026-03-18T18:02:31Z] allocator: kv_alloc failed: requested 128MiB but only 0MiB free
[2026-03-18T18:02:31Z] trace: gpu0 alloc retry
[2026-03-18T18:02:31Z] error: out of memory while pinning KV cache item
... (snip)
```
infra-alex: could be image drift or a native binding in the test harness. dep bump was an npm change but transitive native deps sometimes sneaks in. which commit id was merged?
devops-jen: merged PR 1a2b3c4 — only change listed: `package-lock.json` update. CPU shards green, only smoke-gpu failing in matrix
pkg-team-lead: pinging pkg-team — did the bump pull any native bindings? @pkg-team-lead
pkg-team-lead: checking now, looks like transitive `node-gpu-alloc` bumped 1.0.1 -> 1.1.0 in the lockfile. we didn't intentionally change native code
sam-oncall: running a rerun: `./ci rerun smoke-gpu-allocator-24`
ci-bot: Rerun started by sam-oncall, run id 6490012345-1
sam-oncall: rerun failed with same OOM. starting quick bisect between last-green 6489900000 and 6490012345
devops-jen: good call. if bisect points to transitive native bump we should revert. otherwise maybe a memory leak in the allocator tests
rav-eng-sre: I'll pull the runner image manifest — there was an image rotate earlier today; checking if the CUDA driver changed
pkg-team-lead: found the transitive bump entry, preparing a rollback branch now. will open PR with revert lockfile
sam-oncall: quick workaround — toggling `KV_CACHE_PREFETCH=0` in the test harness drops peak usage locally, trying CI variant now
devops-jen: if that reproduces locally we can add a temporary env override for the suite while we sort this out
pkg-team-lead: creating revert PR and tagging @devops-jen @sam-oncall — will request fast-track if bisect confirms
infra-alex: logging note: if this is native binding, it might only fail under GPU memory pressure. good to include a repro job that reduces batch size and increases chance to fail for bisect
sam-oncall: ETA ~15m for bisect results and the prefetched-off rerun
devops-jen: thanks all. I'll update the incident doc and stand up a quick channel if we need rollback ops. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: Note — rerun and bisect jobs are rate-limited; if you need more capacity ping @eng-sre oncall
pkg-team-lead: revert PR opened: #7421 — tagging for review and fast-track
devops-jen: if #7421 goes green on CI I'll coordinate a revert and redeploy. otherwise we'll keep debugging
sam-oncall: last update — bisect pointed to the transitive native bump (node-gpu-alloc v1.1.0). reproduces with prefetched kv cache on GPU runners. recommending revert and follow-up patch to make tests robust
devops-jen: solid. proceeding with revert plan, thanks everyone. will follow up with postmortem if rollback happens
rav-eng-sre: I'll keep an eye on runner images and file a vendor ticket if driver mismatch discovered
pkg-team-lead: rolling back now, PR linked in thread. :white_check_mark:
devops-jen: closing loop here — thanks for quick response. updating changelog and incident doc.
